description: Embedded SQLite database with serializable transactions and TAGGED values, exactly as fixed by the edge.sql Interface. SQLite semantics are the identity: a database with different SQL, typing, or isolation behavior is a different Form, never an engine token. Values carry their storage class, so a 64-bit INTEGER and a BLOB round-trip losslessly instead of being flattened into a JSON scalar (decision 0020).
title: SQLite Database desired state
